decisions.reason: Displaying the referral code directly on its NFT does not change commission allocation when no referral code is entered.
The existing same-message FAQ MODIFY already records that the revised copy states the referral code appears directly on the NFT.
The new referral-code display location does not change the coded-referral commission trigger, recipient, amount, timing, or delivery.
Displaying the mint-number referral code directly on the NFT does not alter the already-defined transfer semantics.
The referral-code display change does not modify Big Block prize parameters, ticket rules, funding, or draw behavior.
Displaying a referral code on the NFT does not change the prize claim method, announcement channel, or claim URL.
The referral-code display location has no necessary effect on secondary-sale royalties or their allocation.
The referral-code display change does not alter Small Block prize amounts, draw conditions, or pool funding.
Displaying the referral code directly on the NFT does not change badge triggers, thresholds, destination, or function.
The referral-code display location does not change fiat-user authentication, dashboard access, or wallet requirements.
Displaying the referral code on the NFT does not alter primary-sale revenue allocations or fiat-fee treatment.
The referral-code display change does not modify the approved badge catalog.
